verdict.rationale: The only related evidence is the API's audit endpoints (List Audits, Get Audit) alongside controls and an Evidence Library. That suggests audits, controls and evidence are managed as objects inside Drata, but nothing shows an auditor actually logging in or getting a scoped view. missing for 10: a documented auditor role or portal with scoped access to controls and evidence, in-platform auditor review and request workflows that replace emailed PDFs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
